reason: New connector reference for the Organisation Platform, read when a project has that connector; it was shipped only in the Platform's vendored copy until now.

A note before the hand-written chat example says to install the ai-chat module (add-ai-chat) for a chat UI instead of hand-rolling ChocolateFactoryChat, and that a browser call uses stateless mode and the project key because CF's CORS headers expose no X-Conversation-Id and allow no x-agent-key; the rest is unchanged.
